name: COSSAS/SOARCA
description: SOARCA is an open-source CACAO-based security orchestrator that ingests and executes CACAOv2 security playbooks with native HTTP(S), SSH, and OpenC2 capabilities for interfacing with external tools. It implements emerging OASIS standards for security automation.
score_rationale: Niche but standards-compliant SOAR engine with 102 stars, implementing emerging CACAOv2 playbook standards for security orchestration.
